contentVisualRules.portfolio: Real sourced work only; crop and grade may be normalized without changing the result.

consistencyRules.colorPolicy: All navigation imagery must remain in the EVO Quiet Premium 2.0 warm-neutral family.
consistencyRules.retouchPolicy: Generated editorial navigation may be art-directed; factual specialist/portfolio assets preserve real identity and results.
